department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Strict Fall 2027 deadline: January 15, 2027 (Winter term deadline: August 1).
deadline.quote: This program operates on a strict deadline. All application and materials must be submitted by January 15 for Fall consideration and August 1 for Winter consideration.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Electrical and Computer Engineering (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applications are reviewed by the ECE department; enrolled Ph.D. students receive guidance from an assigned faculty advisor and mentor.
supervisor.quote: Ph.D. students receive academic and research guidance from their assigned faculty advisor and mentor.

also.quote: Individual CECS departments review all applications for program admission requirements and make decisions on each applicant.

funding.value: All Ph.D. EECE students receive full funding via GSI and/or GSRA appointments (monthly stipend, health insurance, and tuition waiver) guaranteed for up to 5 years with good standing.
funding.quote: To lessen financial concerns, all PhD students receive full funding in the form of appointments as a graduate student instructor, a research assistant, or both. The appointments provide a monthly stipend, health insurance, and a tuition waiver. Students are guaranteed full funding for up to five years provided they maintain good academic standing and adequate progress toward their degree.

entry_route.value: Admits students with a bachelor's or master's degree in ECE/CS (expected GPA >= 3.2; 36 coursework + 24 dissertation credits for direct B.S. entrants, with optional embedded M.S. in EE or CE).
entry_route.quote: Electrical, Electronics and Computer Engineering (PhD) | Previous Degrees Required | Bachelor or master's degree in electrical and/or computer engineering or computer science with an expected GPA of 3.2 or higher on a 4-point scale

also.quote: The EECE Ph.D. degree requirements include a minimum of 36 credits of coursework and a minimum of 24 credit hours of dissertation credits for Ph.D. students entering the program without a prior M.S. degree.

notes: Rackham Ph.D. in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering offered by UM-Dearborn ECE (core areas: Computer Systems & Networks; Control Systems & Signal Processing; Electronics, Optoelectronics, Power & Energy Systems; Intelligent Systems & Robotics). Separate part-time/working-professional D.Eng. in ECE is excluded.
name: Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering, Ph.D.
